cases.description: Two snapshots of the same content have no change, whatever their manifests say.
cases.name: identical

cases.description: The draft, as a draft pull fetches it, of the same content as a release has no change, and is named as the draft, with its content hash.
cases.name: draft

cases.description: A renamed variable is modified on its key, not removed and added, and each expression and text that names it is modified, the expressions naming what they named (FR-SNAP-04 AC1).
cases.name: renamed-variable

cases.description: Entities that only the to side has are added, named by what their kind shows of them, each node and connection on its board.
cases.name: added

cases.description: Entities that only the from side has are removed, named as the from side has them, each node and connection on the board that it was on.
cases.name: removed

cases.description: Nodes and a connection that the two sides have on different boards are moved, with the board that each was on and the one that it is on, listed on the latter, not removed and added; a moved node whose fields changed too lists them (FR-SNAP-04 AC2).
cases.name: moved

cases.description: A board that only one side has is added or removed, but a node or a connection of it that the other side has on another board is moved, onto the added board or off the removed one, not added or removed with it.
cases.name: rehomed

cases.description: Nodes whose position alone changed are modified and cosmetic, and counted as cosmetic.
cases.name: cosmetic

cases.description: A changed rich text, an element's text or a connection's label, has its plain texts as before and after, and their word-level diff.
cases.name: texts

cases.description: A changed expression, added, removed, or rewritten, has its sources as before and after, and whether the variables, attributes, and nodes that it names changed.
cases.name: expressions

cases.description: A branch output added before others is added, and those whose places moved on are modified on their order; the branch itself, whose own fields did not change, is not.
cases.name: outputs

cases.description: Changed fields of every kind of entity have their values as their files hold them, or no value where a side does not have the field: a retyped variable, a description added, a resetOnEnter taken away, names, options, an attribute's value, tags, a title, a board's name, and the project's.
cases.name: fields

cases.description: A board that only one side has is added or removed with what it holds, and one whose slug, and so its file's path, changed is modified, with nothing that it holds changed.
cases.name: boards

cases.description: Keys that the format does not define, which a consumer ignores, in an object of every kind of entity and at any depth, one that differs from a key that the format defines only by its case among them, and optional fields written with the value that the format leaves out, a board variable's resetOnEnter of false and an element's tags of [], are no change.
cases.name: ignored
